name: StackCalc SC-32 Scientific Calculator
description: Professional 4-Stack Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) Scientific Handheld with 43-key matrix, numerical Brent root solver, adaptive Romberg quadrature, cubic polynomial root finder, TVM financial amortization, vector curve plotting, and full HP-32SII heritage.

hardware.mcu: Raspberry Pi RP2350 Dual-Core ARM Cortex-M33 @ 150MHz
hardware.display: ST7567A Transflective Monochrome Graphic LCD (128x64 pixels, ambient daylight reflective, zero blue light)
hardware.keyboard: 43-key matrix with 400g tactile metal snap-dome switches and dual shift modifiers (f Yellow, g Blue)
hardware.power: 1x CR2032 3V Lithium Coin Cell (6-12 months daily use)
hardware.memory: Flash-backed continuous memory preserving stacks, 26 storage registers A-Z, indirect register (i), equations, and statistical accumulators across sleep and battery swaps
contest_compliance: Texas UIL High School & Middle School Certified
Zero Wireless Radios (No Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, or RF)
Hardware Reset via Hold [C] on Power-Up

stack_levels.description: Active input mantissa and primary result display
Second operand for dyadic calculations (+, -, ×, ÷, yˣ, ÷R, x∥y)
Top register and constant reservoir; duplicates on stack drops

registers.last_x: LAST X register stores operand prior to the most recent operation for error recovery and chain calculation

CMPLX.title: Complex Number Arithmetic
CMPLX.description: Prefix operator using Y=Real and X=Imaginary convention. Evaluates +, -, ×, ÷, √x, eˣ, LN, SIN, COS, TAN in the complex plane, and displays Y + Xi format on [SHOW].

SOLVE.title: Numerical Root Finder
SOLVE.description: Secant and Brent's method root solver for nonlinear equations defined in [EQN]. Converges to real root with |f(x)| < 1e-12.

INTEG.title: Adaptive Romberg Numerical Integration
INTEG.description: Evaluates definite integral from limit a in Y to limit b in X using Romberg extrapolation over adaptive trapezoidal intervals.

POLY.title: Polynomial Root Solver
POLY.description: Solves quadratic (Ax² + Bx + C = 0) and cubic (Ax³ + Bx² + Cx + D = 0) characteristic equations with full real and complex roots.

TVM.title: Time Value of Money Financial Engine
TVM.description: Five-key compound interest solver with N, I%YR, PV, PMT, FV adhering to universal cash-flow sign conventions.

PLOT.title: Basic Function & Scatter Plotting
PLOT.description: Renders 64-point vector curve for active equation or scatter plot with regression overlay on ST7567A display, with coordinate cursor tracing.

operations.name: Stack Lift / Commit
operations.description: Lifts stack contents upwards: copies X into Y, Y into Z, Z into T. Arms stack lift so subsequent digit entry replaces X without pushing.

operations.name: Recall Prior Operand
operations.description: Recalls the value stored in the LAST X register into Register X, lifting the operational stack.

operations.name: Show Full Precision
operations.description: Displays the full unrounded 15-digit internal mantissa and exponent of Register X (or complex pair Y+Xi) until next keypress.

operations.name: Exchange X and Y
operations.description: Exchanges the contents of Registers X and Y. Upper stack registers Z and T remain completely unaffected.
operations.example: 5 [ENTER] 12 [x⇄y] puts 12 in Y and 5 in X

operations.name: Roll Down Stack
operations.description: Cycles all four stack registers downward: X moves to T, T moves to Z, Z moves to Y, and Y moves to X.
operations.example: Inspect all 4 stack levels sequentially without clearing.

operations.name: Roll Up Stack
operations.description: Cycles all four stack registers upward: T moves to X, X moves to Y, Y moves to Z, and Z moves to T.

operations.name: Parallel Resistance / Impedance
operations.description: Calculates parallel combination of two components: (X × Y) / (X + Y) or 1 / (1/X + 1/Y). Drops stack.

operations.name: Addition
operations.description: Adds Y and X. Drops stack; preserves T in T; records previous X in LAST X.

operations.name: Subtraction
operations.description: Subtracts X from Y (Y - X). Drops stack; preserves T in T; records previous X in LAST X.

operations.name: Multiplication
operations.description: Multiplies Y and X. Drops stack; preserves T in T; records previous X in LAST X.

operations.name: Division
operations.description: Divides Y by X (Y ÷ X). Drops stack; preserves T in T; records previous X in LAST X. Errors on zero divisor.

operations.name: Square Root
operations.description: Computes principal square root of X. Supports negative reals when preceded by [CMPLX].

operations.name: Square (x²)
operations.description: Computes X squared (X²).

operations.name: General Power (yˣ)
operations.description: Raises base Y to exponent X (Y^X). Drops stack.

operations.name: X-th Root of Y (ˣ√y)
operations.description: Extracts X-th root of Y (Y^(1/X)). Drops stack.

operations.name: Reciprocal (1/x)
operations.description: Calculates multiplicative inverse 1/X.

operations.name: Natural Logarithm (ln x)
operations.description: Computes natural logarithm base-e of X.

operations.name: Natural Exponential (eˣ)
operations.description: Computes Euler exponential e^X.

operations.name: Common Logarithm (log₁₀ x)
operations.description: Computes base-10 common logarithm of X.

operations.name: Base-10 Exponential (10ˣ)
operations.description: Raises 10 to power X (10^X).

operations.name: Sine
operations.description: Computes trigonometric sine in active angular mode (DEG/RAD/GRAD).

operations.name: Arcsine (sin⁻¹)
operations.description: Computes inverse trigonometric sine.

operations.name: Cosine
operations.description: Computes trigonometric cosine.

operations.name: Arccosine (cos⁻¹)
operations.description: Computes inverse trigonometric cosine.

operations.name: Tangent
operations.description: Computes trigonometric tangent.

operations.name: Arctangent (tan⁻¹)
operations.description: Computes inverse trigonometric tangent.

operations.name: Constant Pi (π)
operations.description: Pushes 15-digit mathematical constant π (3.14159265358979) onto stack.

operations.name: Statistical Accumulate (Σ+)
operations.description: Accumulates coordinate pair (Y=y, X=x) into background summations (Σx, Σy, Σx², Σy², Σxy, n) and returns sample count n in X.

operations.name: Statistical Remove (Σ-)
operations.description: Removes erroneous coordinate pair (Y=y, X=x) from summations.

operations.name: Store to Register
operations.description: Stores value in Register X into named storage register A-Z or indirect register (i). Supports register arithmetic (e.g. STO + A).

operations.name: Recall from Register
operations.description: Recalls value from named storage register A-Z into Register X, lifting stack.

operations.name: Integer Division with Remainder (÷R)
operations.description: Evaluates integer division of Y by X, loading whole quotient Q into X and remainder R into Y.

operations.name: Fraction Display Toggle
operations.description: Toggles display format of Register X between decimal and fractional representation.

operations.name: Plotting Engine
operations.description: Renders active equation curve or regression scatter plot on graphic LCD with coordinate crosshair tracer.
